exceptions.evidence: At basis 1969 both practice sources are unrated and have one five-option radio field. This package validates the indefinite squared-sech and definite sech-tanh families as easy and moderate; no hard workload or source-bank profile is validated. Absence is not proof of impossibility; new source or workload evidence reopens classification.

finite_policy: Easy numerator n=1..12 with denominator 5; moderate integer scale n=3..14 with fixed bounds 1 and 2. Each includes one original excluded task. Further exhaustion must remain explicit; option shuffling and new identities never add tasks.
